CITY OF SAN MARINO

  CITY COUNCIL AGENDA

Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Mayor  www.SanMarinoCA.gov
Tony Chou, Vice Mayor  (626) 300-0700 Phone

Hunter Chang, Council Member  City Hall Council Chamber

John Chou, Council Member  2200 Huntington Drive
Calvin Lo, Council Member  San Marino, CA 91108

Philippe Eskandar, City Manager

  REGULAR MEETING OF THE
  SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 12, 2025 AT 6:00 PM
  CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  2200 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  SAN MARINO, CA 91108
  AND
  NO. 35 HANGZHOU S RD. SEC. 1
  ZHONGZHENG DISTRICT, TAIPEI CITY, TAIWAN

The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council
with valuable information regarding issues of the community.

Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically,
adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m.

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting
should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov or by phone at (626)
300-0705 48 hours prior to the meeting for assistance.

The public is welcome to attend the meeting in person or remotely via Zoom, however, the
meeting will proceed as normal even if there are technical difficulties with Zoom. The City
will do it’s best to resolve any technical issues as quickly as possible.

How to view or listen to the meeting from home:
  Visit www.SanMarinoCA.gov/Zoom

How to offer public comment from home:

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 12, 2025  PAGE 1 of 5
 Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@SanMarinoCA.gov until 3:00 p.m.
the day of the meeting. Written public comment received by 3:00 p.m. will be distributed to
City Council during the meeting. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in
the public comment record but not provided to City Council at the meeting. Written public
comment will also be accepted electronically via the Zoom.us teleconference module during
the meeting. Written Zoom comments will be accepted after the in-person comments. Once
the Mayor calls for Zoom comments, they will be read or summarized in the order received,
then made part of the public record for the meeting. No further Zoom comments will be
read after the conclusion of public comment for that item.

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Council Member Chang, Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Vice Mayor Chou, Mayor
Shepherd Romey

POSTING OF AGENDA

The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall,
2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the
Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website:
http://www.SanMarinoCA.gov.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by
completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At
this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda.
Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the
meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to
place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items.

CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

This is an opportunity for the City Manager to inform the City Council and the public of any
upcoming events or matters of interest to the community.

  NEW BUSINESS

 1.  RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2024-25, 5-
  YEAR FORECAST, AND DISCUSSION ON A 2026 SALES TAX MEASURE

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 12, 2025  PAGE 2 of 5
   Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council: (1) receive and file the
  Financial Transaction Report for FY 2024-25, (2) approve the transfer from the
  General fund to the Capital Projects Fund and necessary budget adjustments, and (3)
  direct staff to return to a future City Council meeting with the appropriate
  declarations, resolutions, and ballot language to place a 1% Transaction and Use Tax
  on the June 2, 2026, ballot for consideration by voters. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to (1) receive and file the Financial Transaction Report for FY 2024-25, (2)
  approve the transfer from the General fund to the Capital Projects Fund and
  necessary budget adjustments, and (3) direct staff to return to a future City Council
  meeting with the appropriate declarations, resolutions, and ballot language to place a
  1% Transaction and Use Tax on the June 2, 2026, ballot for consideration by voters.”

  CONSENT CALENDAR

 2.  APPROVAL  OF  AMENDMENT  NO.  3  TO  TRANSPORTATION
  REIMBURSEMENT AGREEMENT WITH SAN MARINO UNIFIED SCHOOL
  DISTRICT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to
  execute an amendment to the original transportation reimbursement agreement with
  the District for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, for transportation
  reimbursements under the terms described in the attached agreements. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the original
  transportation reimbursement agreement with the San Marino Unified School District
  for transportation reimbursements for the year ended June 30, 2025.”

 3.  APPROVAL OF 2026 LACY PARK MAJOR SPECIAL EVENT PERMIT
  DATES AND CO-SPONSORSHIP REQUESTS

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the 2026 Lacy Park Special
  Event Permit Dates and Fee Requests. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  "I move to approve the 2026 Lacy Park Special Event Permit Dates and Co-
  Sponsorship Requests.”

 4.  ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. R-25-36, A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN MARINO, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING
  THE BLANKET AUTHORITY TO FILE APPLICATIONS FOR GRANT FUNDS
  FROM THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY REGIONAL PARKS AND OPEN SPACE
  DISTRICT FOR MEASURE A FUNDING FOR PROJECTS AND PROGRAMS,
  AND AUTHORIZE THE CITY MANAGER TO EXECUTE THE MEASURE A
  ANNUAL ALLOCATION GRANT AGREEMENT

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 12, 2025  PAGE 3 of 5
   Recommendation: Staff recommend the City Council 1) adopt Resolution No. R-25-
  36, A Resolution of the City Council of the City of San Marino, California, approving
  the blanket authority to file applications for grant funds from the Los Angeles County
  Regional Park and Open Space District for Measure A funding for projects and
  programs, and 2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Measure A Annual
  Allocation Grant Agreement. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation,
  an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to 1) adopt Resolution No. R-25-36, A Resolution of the City Council of the
  City of San Marino, California, approving the blanket authority to file applications for
  grant funds from the Los Angeles County Regional Park and Open Space District for
  Measure A funding for projects and programs, and 2) authorize the City Manager to
  execute the Measure A Annual Allocation Grant Agreement.”

 5.  APPROVAL OF NOTICE OF COMPLETION FOR YEAR 4 OF THE ANNUAL
  SIDEWALK REPLACEMENT PROGRAM

  Recommendation: Staff recommend that the City Council: 1) accept Year 4 of the
  Sidewalk Replacement Program as complete, and 2) authorize the City Clerk to file
  the Notice of Completion. If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to accept Year 4 of the Multi-Year Sidewalk Replacement Program No. 25-
  9272 performed by CJ Concrete Construction, Inc., as complete, and authorize the
  City Clerk to file the Notice of Completion with the Los Angeles County Registrar-
  Recorder/County Clerk.”

 6.  REAPPOINTMENT TO THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF THE GREATER LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY VECTOR CONTROL DISTRICT

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council reappoint Howard Brody as the
  City’s representative to the Greater Los Angeles County Vector Control District Board
  of Trustees to serve a two (2) year term. If the City Council concurs with staff’s
  recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  ”I move to reappoint Howard Brody to serve on the Board of Trustees for the Greater
  Los Angeles Vector Control District for a two (2) year term ending January 1, 2028.

 7.  AUTHORIZATION TO DISPOSE OF SURPLUS PROPERTY BY PUBLIC
  AUCTION PER MUNICIPAL CODE SECTION 2.06.06

  Recommendation: Staff recommend the City Council approve the disposal of surplus
  equipment via public auction pursuant to Municipal Code Section 2.06.06. If the City
  Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the disposal of surplus equipment as listed in the staff report via
  public auction, pursuant to Municipal Code Section 2.06.06.”

 8.  APPROVAL  OF A  FIRST AMENDMENT TO THE AMENDED  AND
  RESTATED  CITY  MANAGER  EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT  AND

AGENDA – NOVEMBER 12, 2025  PAGE 4 of 5
   CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. R-25-37 TO REVISE THE
  SALARY SCHEDULE

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council approve a First Amendment to
  the Amended and Restated City Manager Employment Agreement and adopt
  Resolution No. R-25-37, amending the salary schedule. If the City Council agrees, an
  appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to approve the First Amendment to the Amended and Restated City Manager
  Employment Agreement Between the City of San Marino and Philippe Eskandar and
  to Adopt Resolution No. R-25-37.”

 9.  RECEIVE AND  FILE  MONTHLY  DISBURSEMENTS  REPORTS  FOR
  OCTOBER 2025

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council receive and file the Monthly
  Disbursements Report for the month of October 2025. If the City Council concurs
  with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

  “I move to receive and file the Monthly Disbursements Report for the month of
  October 2025.”

 10. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council approve the October 2025 Minutes.
  If the City Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion
  would be:

  “I move to approve the Minutes of the Special Meeting of October 7, 2025, the
  Adjourned Regular Meeting of October 7, 2025, and the Special Meeting of October
  31, 2025.”

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION

This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City
received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San
Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be
made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San
Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will
available for review at the City Council meeting.

FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS

ADJOURNMENT

Posted: 11/07/2025  ALISON WALKER
  CITY CLERK
